test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence.

Rajib is not only an extremely reputed conoisseur of art but also a successful entrepreneur.
solution:
The correct answer is- **"conoisseur"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options,** "conoisseur"** is the incorrectly spelt word.
 
• The correct spelling of the word is-*** "******connoisseur"***.
 
• The word **Connoisseur** means- An expert, one who understands the specifics, technique, or principles of an art and is competent to act as a critical judge.
 
 
• **Example:** A connoisseur of music.
 
 
 
• ​Thus, ***option 1)*** is the correct alternative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us understand the meaning of other options too.

 
• **Reputed: **Respected/ having a good Repute

 
 
• **Example:** Mr. James is a very reputed** businessman** in the country.
 
 
 
• **Entrepreneur: **an individual who creates a new business
 
 
• **Example:** The government has issued the new guidelines for the small entrepreneurs.
 
 
 
• **Successful: **having obtained your goals; becoming well-known, wealthy, etc.
 
 
• **Example:** One must work hard to become **successful **in life.
